Install the CLI

The command line tool is a single static binary. Download it, make it executable and place it on your path. Verify the installation by asking for its version, which prints a short string and exits.

Steps

  1. Download the archive for your platform
  2. Unpack it
  3. Run tool --version
curl -fsSLO https://example.com/tool.tar.gz
tar xzf tool.tar.gz
./tool --version

Flags

FlagMeaning
--jsonPrint JSON
--quietNo progress output

For the full reference see the reference and the support address.
